enemy-079-albino-reef-stalker.designLock: PROJECT_ADAPTATION albino marine ecophenotype derived from the reviewed project Reef Stalker. Preserve one low, long, streamlined amphibious XX121-derived quadruped with a smooth eyeless dome, biomechanical ribs, exactly two forelimbs and two hindlimbs, low flattened dorsal fin-plates and exactly one complete propulsive segmented tail ending in one contained vertical swimming blade. Albino changes pigment/material response only: warm pearl and pale parchment shell, cool ash-gray wet recesses, restrained translucent rose-taupe joints and faint sea-glass cyan bioluminescent pinpoints; salt and algae deposits remain sparse gray-green, never a green body wash. It must remain distinct from Albino Reef Spitter: no raised narrow cranium, no throat gland, no projectile posture and no acid sac. Strict orthographic gameplay profile facing RIGHT in all clips. No fish eyes, fish face, giant gills, shark mouth, tentacles, extra limbs, second tail, weapon, snow/ice theme, flat-white silhouette, copied predecessor pixels, official-model claim or 1:1 claim. Every future pixel is newly authored project art; canonExact=false.

designDetails.silhouette: Very low and long quadruped; smooth eyeless dome flows into a flattened ribbed back. Four limbs remain individually readable beneath the body. Low fin-plates never become spikes. One long tail ends in one vertical swimming blade.
designDetails.palette: Warm pearl/parchment outer shell, ash-gray wet rib recesses, restrained rose-taupe joints, minute cyan sea-glass accents and sparse gray-green reef staining. Not pure white, pink domestic flesh, blue recolor or icy crystal.
designDetails.reefEcology: A stealth and pursuit ecophenotype for flooded reef corridors: low drag, fin-stabilized turns, salt-wet shell and compact swimming blade. Environmental adaptation does not add fish anatomy.
designDetails.orientation: Strict right-facing orthographic side profile, one whole subject per cell; head and swimming blade remain inside generous gutters.
designDetails.root: New art requires 32 independent pelvis/lower-ribcage-to-planted-foot or resting-body-plane anchors. Tail blade, dome extrema and bounds center are forbidden root proxies.
designDetails.scale: New art requires an independent inter-clip scale review using the rigid dome-base-to-pelvis/body-axis length. Do not inherit base numeric factors or measure tail/fin extrema.
designDetails.background: True alpha or perfectly uniform #FF00FF only; no reef scenery, water caustics, floor, shadow, grid, text, UI or checkerboard.

actionLocks.idle: Eight grounded low alert/breathing poses; tiny dome, rib, fin-base and tail-base motion only, with four feet and one swimming blade continuously readable.
actionLocks.move: Eight-phase low quadruped run with diagonal contacts, compression, extension and recovery; never bipedal, airborne for the whole cycle or translated across cells.
actionLocks.attack: Eight-phase crouch and short pounce/bite into empty space, clear anticipation/contact/follow-through/four-foot recovery; no spit, detached effect or fish lunge.
actionLocks.death: Lethal impact, four-limb support loss, lateral collapse and terminal motionless body; dome, fins, limbs and single tail/blade remain attached.
